//: Markup-fidelity fixture for the LIST CONTAINER — the complex/structured `.pa-list` block (keen `PureAdmin.Components.List.list/1`, svelte `display/List.svelte`). SCOPE = CONTAINER ONLY. The harness renders one component whose slot receives plain TEXT (the dumper HTML-escapes it), so item markup can't flow through the slot; the body area is a bare text token. Per-item structure (pa-list__item / __avatar / __content / __title / __subtitle / __meta) is covered by the list-item FRAGMENT fixture — see the `deferred` block (verified: capability confirms list-item actually renders each). This fixture proves ONLY what the container itself emits: its tag, its pa-list class, and its class passthrough. Note the SIBLING blocks pa-list-basic / pa-list-ordered / pa-list-definition (keen basic_list/ordered_list/definition_list; svelte has none) are DIFFERENT components and OUT OF SCOPE.

propsVocabulary.body: the list's item area — filled with plain slot text in this container-only slice (real pa-list__item children are the deferred sub-slice)
propsVocabulary.extraClass: extra classes appended verbatim (svelte `class`, keen `class`) — class passthrough, not a core feature
propsVocabulary.as: GONE (rc10): the container is ALWAYS <ul class="pa-list" role="list"> — one canonical shape, like every other core list (pa-list-basic <ul>, pa-list-ordered <ol>, pa-list-definition <dl>, pa-timeline <ul>). The block owns its list reset; role="list" restores list semantics WebKit/VoiceOver drops under list-style:none. keen's former as=div|ul and the <div> form are removed.

goldenConventions: The container is <ul role="list">; role="list" is part of the canonical shape. The body slot is a plain text token (Body) so the diff checks the container's tag + class + nesting, not rich item content. Attribute + class-token order and whitespace are normalized away, so goldens are written for readability.

features.//: Feature→class contract authored from dist/css/main.css. The .pa-list BLOCK has ZERO modifiers (no pa-list--* exists at all — grep '\.pa-list--' on main.css is empty) and its only classes are the six DEFERRED __element classes below. So the container contract is minimal: the base class + a body slot + a class passthrough. capability.mjs axis-1 reverse-check is scoped to block modifiers (pa-list--*), of which there are none; the per-item __element classes are deferred to the list-item fixture (verified).

body.note: structural — the container's inner content; item structure is the deferred sub-slice

extraClass.note: class passthrough — appended verbatim, not a core feature

deferred.//: Per-ITEM element classes of the pa-list block — not container markup. Covered by the list-item FRAGMENT fixture; { fixture: list-item } makes capability VERIFY each one is actually produced/rendered there (not just silenced).

scenarios.name: extra-class
